result.png.shows: The four artifacts with the judge's measured numbers drawn on them: the Shepard chroma glide against its analytic fit and the 3.0-octave spec floor; the ball's bottom edge per frame with the measured floor row and each bounce marked; the QR code and the 5-colour palette card.

loop.png.shows: Self-test kill rate: each known-bad mutant and whether the judge killed it (15/15 = 100%).

demo.mp4.shows: 36 s animation of the judged artifact: the bouncing ball GIF frame by frame with the judge's bounce marks, the Shepard chroma glide drawing itself against its fit and the spec floor, and the WAV envelope with a playhead.
demo.mp4.command: python3 media/make_video.py examples/good media/master/demo.mkv --seed 42 --fps 30 && ffmpeg -i media/master/demo.mkv -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart media/demo.mp4

data/selftest.json.shows: Raw self-test result: the gate that killed each mutant.
